about: Void Squid's seed catalogue: games Void Squid has an ingest route for, and the community projects those routes read for names and structure (never copied). Written for Void Squid. Titles and links are facts; no game data is here. The larger community list is downloaded on the person's machine by `effect catalogue refresh`.

games.title: Super Mario Galaxy
games.route: exercise toolbox (../ds-mashup): BCSV placements, J3D models and materials, KCL collision, gravity fields, AST music; Petari read for class and folder names only
games.notes: The disc image must be extracted first (Dolphin's 'Extract Entire Disc').

games.title: Super Mario 64 DS
games.route: exercise toolbox (../ds-mashup): NSBMD models through apicula, KCL collision
games.notes: No full decompilation was found. The route reads data, not code.

games.title: Mario Kart DS
games.route: exercise toolbox (../ds-mashup): course and item models through apicula

games.title: Mario Party DS
games.route: exercise toolbox (../ds-mashup): board and character models through apicula

games.title: Donkey Kong 64
games.route: exercise toolbox (../ds-mashup): map geometry and textures through dk64_lib (GPL-3, invoked in its own environment, never imported); setups and pickups read by the toolbox
games.notes: dk64_lib is on PyPI. Collision and model-two geometry are not decoded yet.

games.title: Super Mario 64
games.notes: A complete matching decompilation. No Void Squid route yet.
